title: Funky Dirt — releases and updates
description: New releases, videos and news from Funky Dirt, a Sri Lankan funk, pop and rap trio from Colombo.

items.title: Sereppuwa — new single
items.summary: Funky Dirt's 2026 single Sereppuwa features Aruja AJ, with lyrics by Murshad Huvais and music by Shenal Maddumage.
items.content_text: Sereppuwa is a 2026 single by Sri Lankan trio Funky Dirt, featuring Aruja AJ. Lyrics by Murshad Huvais; music by Shenal Maddumage. Stream it on Spotify and watch the official video on YouTube.

items.title: Oba Dakmen — PPL official theme song
items.summary: Funky Dirt's 2025 single Oba Dakmen was selected as the PPL official theme song.
items.content_text: Oba Dakmen is a 2025 single by Funky Dirt and the PPL official theme song. Stream it on Spotify, Apple Music and YouTube Music.

items.title: Hollala — official lyrics video
items.summary: The official Hollala lyrics video, with music, mixing and mastering by Shenal Maddumage.
items.content_text: Hollala (හොල්ලලා) by Funky Dirt is available on all streaming platforms. The official lyrics video is on YouTube. Music, mix and master by Shenal Maddumage.

items.title: Awidan Yanawa with Yohani
items.summary: Funky Dirt's 2021 collaboration with Yohani, featuring Shenal and Murshad.
items.content_text: Awidan Yanawa is a 2021 collaboration between Yohani and Funky Dirt, featuring Shenal and Murshad. Music by Shenal Maddumage; lyrics by Murshad Huvais.

items.title: Book Funky Dirt for your event
items.summary: Weddings, private parties, corporate events, festivals and international shows. Send a booking request through the site.
items.content_text: Funky Dirt performs at weddings, private parties, birthdays, corporate events, festivals and college gigs, and accepts international bookings. Book 3–6 months ahead for private events and 6–12 months ahead for major events and festivals.
